{{- /* Where a folded API reference member lives: its section on the parent symbol's page. Expects: the member page. Returns dict "parent" (the parent symbol's page, nil when the member is not folded or its parent is missing) and "id" (the section's anchor, the member's title anchorized: `IChartConfig.colors` -> `ichartconfigcolors`, the same in HTML and Markdown). */ -}} {{- $parent := "" -}} {{- if .Params.folded -}} {{- with .Params.parent_symbol }}{{ $parent = $.CurrentSection.GetPage . }}{{ end -}} {{- end -}} {{- return dict "parent" $parent "id" (anchorize .Title) -}}
